eval.title: Verizon Stock - A Dividend Stock To Buy (Cheaper Now Than What Buffett Paid)

call.headline_quote: you can see how the intrinsic value is slightly above the current stock price of 56 for a 10 return

base_metric.name: dps
base_metric.quote: i have taken the dividend because that's what warren buffett is likely looking at

scenarios.name: normal
scenarios.quote: i have put a 7 dividend growth rate in the first five years and then 10 as they reach profitability with the 5g a 5 dividend yield expected in 2030 and that leads to a stock price of almost 100 for an intrinsic value of 58 for a 10 discount rate

scenarios.name: best
scenarios.quote: in the best case scenario let's say the dividend growth is even faster in the long term and the market is happy with the four percent dividend yield we have more than double stock price and higher and higher dividend for an even higher intrinsic current value

reasons.claim: The intrinsic value from his dividend model is slightly above the current price, implying about a 10% return.
reasons.quote: you can see how the intrinsic value is slightly above the current stock price of 56 for a 10 return

data_check.gap_note: not in our data: intrinsic value

reasons.claim: Buffett bought this as his second-largest ever purchase at a price close to or below today's, which he treats as a signal of opportunity.
reasons.quote: it is the second largest ever warren buffett purchase he spent 8.6 billion on his current position the stock price is a little bit lower than what he paid

data_check.gap_note: not in our data: buffett purchase size

reasons.claim: Verizon has the highest return on invested capital among the three-player oligopoly, indicating the strongest competitive position.
reasons.quote: if we look at verizon you can see here in digits teen returns over invested capital that is also what warren buffett is looking at with high returns on invested capital comparing to the competition

reasons.claim: As 5G capex subsides in coming years, free cash flow and profitability should rise, supporting higher dividends.
reasons.quote: in it one two three years 5g will be positioned will be done the capex will start going down and the profitability is likely to start going up

data_check.gap_note: trajectory visible at T0; no number stated

reasons.claim: High debt load is a risk, though he considers it manageable relative to operating cash flow and partly mitigated by Buffett's stake.
reasons.quote: on the other risks there is that 107 billion i think
